title: Validation-Wait Credit and Complimentary Names
content:
### SSL/TLS Certificates — calculation note: validation-wait credit and complimentary names

**When a credit arises.** A multi-domain certificate subscription is owed a validation-wait compensation once where its first certificate — the issuance of kind initial in its service history — was issued after its order date, while its service history shows no issuance of kind reissue and its billing carries no added-names line.

**The credit.** The validation-wait credit is the number of calendar days from the order date to the issue date of the first certificate; these are its waiting days. Every multiplier of the waiting days acts first, every number of days added to the validation-wait credit is then added, and every percentage share acts on that total, which is rounded down to a whole day.

**Names earned.** Each full 3 days of the validation-wait credit earn one complimentary name: the complimentary names are the credit divided by 3 and rounded down to a whole name.

**Room on the certificate.** Never more complimentary names are given than the product's largest number of names leaves room for beside the names already covered, that is, the product's largest number of names less its included names and less the extra names the subscription already records. Both are figures of the certificate product the subscription holds.

**Nothing booked.** Where the calculation comes to no name — because the first certificate was not issued after the order date, a reissue or an added-names line is already on record, the credit earns no full 3 days, or the certificate has no room — nothing is booked.

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| order date | the subscription |
| first certificate issue date | the initial issuance in the service history |
| reissues on record | issuances of kind reissue in the service history |
| added-names lines | the subscription's billing history |
| extra names already covered | the subscription |

**Worked example (hypothetical).** A Harborline DV Multi-Domain subscription is ordered on 12 September 2031 and its first certificate is issued on 5 October 2031; it records 63 extra names, and its service history and billing show no reissue and no added-names line. The validation-wait credit is 23 days. 23 divided by 3 is 7 and two thirds, rounded down to 7 complimentary names. The product's largest number of names leaves room for many more than 7 beside the included and 63 extra names, so 7 complimentary names are owed.

**Second hypothetical.** The same credit of 23 days on a subscription with room for only 2 more names gives 2 complimentary names. A credit of 2 days gives no name, and nothing is booked.
